title: Brand Voice & Local Culture (Addis Ababa)
content: Addis Pizza Co. targets urban young adults (aged 18-35) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Voice should be energetic, hospitable ('enqutatash' friendly vibe), featuring popular neighborhood references (Bole, Kazanchis, Piassa, Sarbet). Use lively emojis (🍕, 🔥, 😋). Emphasize authentic wood-fired crust and fresh local cheeses.

title: Social Media Format Guidelines
content: For Instagram: Keep caption under 150 words, hook within the first 2 lines before the fold, exactly 4-6 hashtags placed at the bottom, and a clear call to action directing users to phone orders or link in bio. For LinkedIn: Professional tone, highlight business entrepreneurship, culinary quality, and workplace catering.

title: Offer Terms & Legal Compliance
content: All promotional discounts must specify 'Valid while supplies last' or 'Terms apply'. Never make medical or absolute nutritional health claims. Direct all customer orders to phone hotline (+251-911-000000) or official delivery partners.
